record_type_quote: The purpose of this study was to conduct a cross-cultural, conceptual replication of the study reported in Beghetto, Kaufman, and Baxter (2011), which examined the relationship between elementary students’ creative self-efficacy (CSE) beliefs, their demographic characteristics, and teacher ratings of students’ creative expression during science instruction.
